name: Retal Urban Development Company
summary: Retal Urban Development Company, through its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate developer in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through the Real Estate Development, Investment, and Other segments. The company engages in the construction, purchase, sale, and rental of land and real estate; general cleaning, maintenance, and operation of buildings, gardens, parks, and sports facilities; erection, management, and maintenance of industrial, commercial and service projects, restaurants, central markets, residential compounds, and commercial and industrial complexes; general contracting for residential, commercial, public, educational, recreational, medical, airport, and precast buildin…
